title: Woman Holding Yawning Baby on Porch, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A tender domestic black-and-white snapshot depicting a smiling woman seated outside on a wicker chair holding a tiny seven-week-old baby swaddled in a plush satin-trimmed blanket. The newborn is caught mid-yawn with its mouth open wide, while the mother or caregiver gazes down affectionately. They are positioned beside a multi-pane window with wooden horizontal Venetian blinds, bathed in natural sunlight. The woman wears a short-sleeved patterned day dress typical of the 1940s home front era.
